mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when HOUST falls by more than 10% in two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Industrial Production Index exceeding 2% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls by more than 2% in three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS falls by more than 3% in three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% in three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls by more than 4.5 percentage points in three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% combined with a 3-month decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% signals a broad-based weakening in consumer and housing demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when both RSAFS falls by more than 3% and HOUST falls by more than 10% in three months (t-test p > 0.05).
